browser: Installed Google Chrome via Playwright channel chrome
fixture: New isolated anonymous browser identity. Every movement, edit, quest action and flight transition uses actual UI/keyboard/touch controls. APIs below only read acknowledged state.
checks: Real closed-door blocking, explicit entry/exit, saved room rearrangement, room movement and same interior after reload
Ordinary structure edited in place with private name/groups retained
Ordinary Path rotated, newly placed and removed through Build
Real takeoff, radius-aware piloting, public landing, actual delivery, return flight and room re-entry
Edits and quest survive the complete journey and refresh
